transcript.line: You catch fragments by the fire — Feryal telling Latifa about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
🌿 Latifa returns from foraging the wilds: +224 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 223 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
👥 Olga heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably." The pantry won't fill itself.
👥 Latifa walks out with Olga. "Nobody walks alone today."
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Feryal — Field 2. Three offers; they took Dowsing. Earned, chosen. (dowsing: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Feryal chose Dowsing (dowsing) at Field 2.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
PATIENT AIM: first strike -- and your training piles on. (x2.30)

OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Theo Lindqvist is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Theo Lindqvist is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Theo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Feryal blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Theo's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Theo Lindqvist, 107 days. The mantle passes to Feryal Henein.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Feryal Henein, 29 — a hunting guide. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Dowsing.
The village's quarrel was with Theo — and Theo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
The fire knew Feryal before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

transcript.line: Not in the middle of a fight.
You walk back into Haven. 69 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
🚪 BARRIER CROSSED — you crash through into Haven. The gate shuts behind you. The wild goes quiet. (Haven is safe — nothing follows you here.)
You escape. The thicket keeps its secrets.
And they're GONE! The gamblers who bet on a fight are furious. The ones who bet on running are rich.
You lived to tell it — The Reunion's moves are burned into your memory. (1/2 — one more survived encounter and you'll have its trick.)
